reviews.text: Sad to be writing this review, but happy to give praise where it’s deserved! Amanda and her team have been phenomenal with my dog Hank for the past 4 years. I’m moving out of PB and I’d be lucky to find a groomer that my dog even half as enjoys as Diego Dogs.

I seriously can’t recommend Diego Dogs enough! I was struggling for a while to find a groomer I felt comfortable bringing my reactive German Shepherd to, and finding this place has been such a relief. They always make her feel so welcome and comfortable, and I never have to worry when I drop her off, which means so much to me.

On top of that, she always looks SO good when I pick her up! You can tell they genuinely care about the dogs they work with and take the time to make sure they feel safe. I’m so thankful to have found such an amazing groomer right in my neighborhood.

I am so grateful to have been referred to Diego Dogs by everyone I asked when I moved here last year.  Amanda runs a very professional operation and I know my fur baby is in the best hands here. Her knowledge of our pets is quite extensive and I trust her completely. On a personal level, Amanda is such a lovely person and a pleasure to know.

I LOVED my experience here. The price was very very affordable and the groomer made my pup look like a new dog. I have a cavalier King Charles so there is a lot of specific details that goes into his grooming. The groomer listened to everything I wanted and exceeded my expectations. My little guy got so many compliments.
Your review has been reported to google as you are not a client of this buisness.
So kind and always making our puppy look the best 😄 …
You are so wonderful thank you for your support . We are happy to have you as a member of Diego dogs family

Without a doubt the best groomer in San Diego, if not the world. Amanda, the owner, is so sweet and gentle with all the animals she grooms. She will treat your fur baby as if it were her own. My poodle always looks fantastic after a day at the spa. Amanda is also a certified Reiki Master and is highly in tune with the energy of animals - your baby will not only look great, but will also feel calmer and happier after a visit to Diego Dogs. If I could give more than 5 stars I would 🩷
They don’t answer the phone.  Can’t speak to grooming but very frustrating customer service.

Our dog loves this place! A great haircut and customer service for a wonderful price. They do a great job on our Aussidoodle who has curly hair and can be difficult at some groomers. I highly recommend Diego dogs!
They did an amazing job on our little Boogie. She looks great and it shows. She prances around the house showing off her new hair-do. 🐶 …

For starters- I have a wild little man that has been coming here for 2 years now I think. We are so grateful for how kind and wonderful the staff is here even with our crazy frenchie I’m sure giving them a run for their money. Thank you Diego Dogs for taking such good care of Roman! His humans appreciate you:)

These ladies always go above and beyond to accommodate our needs. All the dogs get special and kind attention. They are very professional, but loving at the same time. They will accommodate any requests and take good notes on the account to communicate your dogs' needs to all the staff in the future. Rémy approved! 🐺 …

I have finally found the best groomer! After trying different places around SD, I knew I was in the right place when Donna called me! The amount of professionalism, personal attention, and love they showed for not only my fur baby, but myself as well really sealed it! My dog was a mess, and he came out looking amazing and he was happy. If I could give Diego Dogs Grooming 10 stars ⭐️ I would! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
